sentences.text:
Bench: B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Honourable Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Writ Petition No.21365 Of 2024
Order:

This writ petition is filed to declare the inaction of respondent Nos.3 and 4 pursuant to the representations submitted by the petitioner on 08.01.2024 and 09.03.2024, as being arbitrary and unconstitutional.
2. The case of the petitioner is that he is resident of Adilabad Town.
One day, he visited some wine shops at Adilabad Town.

He observed that the owners of wine shops are not maintaining the wine shops strictly in accordance with the conditions of license and are doing illegal business by selling food in the permit rooms which is illegal as per the Excise Act.
The petitioner suffered illness due to unhygienic conditions in the wine shop.
Many of the wine shops in Adilabad Town are selling soda in disposable glasses and unhygienic food without the approval of Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI).

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The petitioner made several oral complaints to the respondent authorities to take action against the wine shops who are conducting business contrary to the conditions laid down in the conditions of license.
Later, the petitioner lodged complaints dated 07.02.2022, 08.01.2024 and 09.03.2024.
However, there is no action from the respondent authorities.

3. Heard Mr. S. Ravi Kiran Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner, and Mr. S. Laxminarayana,
learned Assistant Government Pleader for Prohibition and Excise, and perused the material available on record.
4.
Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Prohibition and Excise submitted that the writ petition is not maintainable.
The petitioner does not have locus standi to seek for a general order against all the wine shops in Adilabad Town.
The petitioner has not made any specific complaint against the wine shops.
The allegations made in the affidavit are very vague.
It is stated that all the wine shops in Adilabad Town have A4 licence and they are selling Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL) as per conditions of license.
They are not selling water bottles, food and other beverages to the customers within the licensed premises as alleged by the petitioner.
Ten A4 shops are established in Adilabad Town with permit rooms within the prescribed norms.
The permit rooms allow customers to consume liquor that is purchased from A4 shop.
The permit rooms do not entitle to sell food and other beverages to consumers.
A4 shops and their permit rooms are run within the demarcated boundaries as per license certificate issued by the District Prohibition and Excise Officer, Adilabad.

The authorities regularly inspect A4 shops and permit rooms and also the books D. Sudheer Kumar vs The State Of Telangana on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97265211/
1 maintained by them, and so far, they have not found any violations.

entities.text: D. Sudheer Kumar vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As and when violations are found, necessary action will be taken against A4 shops.

5. In the above facts and circumstances, taking into consideration that vague allegations are made by the petitioner and no specific complaint is lodged alleging violations by any A4 shop owners in Adilabad Town; and more so as it is stated by the learned Assistant Government Pleader that during inspection made by the Prohibition and Excise officials, no violations are found against A4 shops,
this Court is not inclined to entertain the writ petition.
6. Recording the above submissions, the writ petition is disposed of.
However, the petitioner is at liberty to point out specific violations of any of A4 shops, and on such violations being pointed out

,
the respondent authorities shall take necessary action in accordance with law.
No order as to costs.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous applications, if any, pending in this writ petition stand closed.

B. VIJAYSEN REDDY, J Date: 13-08-2024 vv D. Sudheer Kumar vs The State Of Telangana on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97265211/
